fields.title: CIPO entity search-result / detail record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_searchType/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Field names and casing mirror upstream's own JSON verbatim (including its 'Schareholders' typo on detail records), since this actor calls CIPO's e-Filing portal's own internal REST API directly.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact search term that produced this record.

_searchType.title: Search type
_searchType.description: entities, directors, or shareholders -- which register field _input was matched against.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-ocrs-entitysearch (search row only), S1-ocrs-entitysearch+entityinfo (search row enriched with a follow-up Directors/Secretaries/Shareholders lookup), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), invalid_query (term contains an unsupported ',' or '=' character), upstream_error (CIPO's own API returned an error message, e.g. its 'Divide by zero' bug on overly broad queries), or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

EntityID.title: Entity ID
EntityID.description: CIPO's internal GUID for this entity -- used to fetch the Directors/Secretaries/Shareholders detail lookup.

EntityName.title: Entity name
EntityName.description: Registered name of the company or business name.

EntityNumber.title: Registration number
EntityNumber.description: Official CIPO registration/incorporation number (e.g. 2015/C3170 for an IBC, or a legacy plain number for an older local registration).

DateOfIncorporation.title: Date of incorporation
DateOfIncorporation.description: Registration/incorporation date on file, as returned by CIPO (not normalized).

TypeName.title: Entity type
TypeName.description: e.g. Private Ordinary Company, Business By Firm.

PrincipalOfficeAddress.title: Principal office address
PrincipalOfficeAddress.description: Registered/principal office address on file, as a single free-text string.

registry.title: Registry
registry.description: Which CIPO register this entity is filed under (always 'COMPANIES & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OFFICE' for Dominica).

ApplicationId.title: Application ID
ApplicationId.description: Directors/shareholders search mode only: internal jurisdiction GUID.

Email.title: Email
Email.description: Directors/shareholders search mode only: contact email on file, when present.

Directors.title: Directors
Directors.description: Comma-separated director names on file, as a single free-text string (not a structured list) -- present on directors/shareholders search-mode rows, and re-supplied by the detail lookup for entities-mode rows.

Secretaries.title: Secretaries
Secretaries.description: Comma-separated company secretary names on file, same free-text shape as Directors.

Shareholders.title: Shareholders
Shareholders.description: Comma-separated shareholder names on file (correct spelling; only present on directors/shareholders search-mode rows).

Schareholders.title: Shareholders (detail lookup)
Schareholders.description: Same data as Shareholders, but from the separate detail (EntityInfo) lookup -- upstream spells this field 'Schareholders' (typo) on that endpoint; kept verbatim rather than silently corrected.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-result and detail-enriched records.
